text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp.
The season for special training had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "During this period, many Umamusume dedicate themselves to intensive training, but—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, it's vacation time!
Vacation!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why such a serious face, Trainer?
Even though it's our precious free time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In the West, work and play are strictly separated.
You have to draw a clear line between the two.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This summer, I'll have a tropical juice in hand and fool around foolishly! Ho-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seems to be getting hyped up in an entirely different direction. When I remind her to focus properly on training as well...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
――Understand. I get it.
Only during break time, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's play and run, and savor the prime of our youthâ
or rather, our summerâª
Don't worry, the world is right before our eyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A fully composed Seeking the Pearl.
And—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is there something in that tree...?
It feels like it's watching us...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A sniper, perhaps? Or maybe a Canadian-born grizzly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap...!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh... just a bird...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems even the wild beasts
can't take their eyes off me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come along, Trainer.
Let's start with a swim, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl walked away, but...
...Fufu, fufufufu.
Yes... That is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the tree the bird flew from,
I thought I heard a faint laugh.
